### 1016. An `\IEEEmembership` grade is the reading's contact, its owner the name it follows (P5a)

**TeX.** IEEEtran.cls:4525 `\def\IEEEmembership#1{{…\normalfont…\textit{#1}}}` prints the grade wherever it is called,
after a name, in a note, in a biography heading; conference mode swallows it (IEEEtran.cls:6270) unless
`\IEEEoverridecommandlockouts` (:6278-6288). **Perl.** IEEEtran.cls.ltxml:143 `DefMacro('\IEEEmembership{}', '')`:
every grade dropped. **Rust.** Where the frontmatter reads the author field — its rehearsal and the flush that digests
what the emitter wrote (`reading_author_fields`) — `\IEEEmembership{…}` is `\lx@IEEE@grade` (conference-gated). In the
rehearsal it is a `membership` Contact event (`\lx@add@contact[role=membership]`), and the resolver gives it to the
name before it in its names line (`owner:adjacent`), or, on a line printing only the grade and notes right under the
names, to the last name above (`line:contact membership:name-above`, 2202.10869). A grade no name comes before is no
one's (P5a2, review revP5a B1/S1): one on a line the reading took for an affiliation — after a name it read as that
line's text (2408.01956, 2511.20003), ending an affiliation line, inside `\IEEEauthorblockA` or authblk's `\affil`, a
grade line under an affiliation line — is never a contact of the line's holders; at the flush the grade prints its
text where the emitter wrote it (its contact, or that line's text, as the PDF prints it), and one the resolver places
nowhere (alone under an affiliation, before any name: no `owner:block`) is the emitter's net's note, counted by its
Warning. The grade's meaning is reached however it is
spelled — a macro (`\newcommand\memb{\IEEEmembership}`, bindsplit ie3), a macro taking it, a `\let` copy — where the
token cut `name_memberships` (deleted, with `names_continue`, `names_list_continues`, `notes_only_line` and
`hoist_wrapped_separators`, which only it reached) moved each spelled `\IEEEmembership` before the comma for the
API's split. Elsewhere (a biography heading, the body) whose author cannot be known, the grade is dropped as in Perl
(2408.01902); an empty grade prints nothing (1805.06045); a comma opening or ending a grade is the list's (2408.00327). A grade
inside an author's `\thanks` is the note's text, printed there at the flush (P5a2; P5a dropped it, counted:
`ieee_membership_grade_inside_a_thanks_is_the_notes_text`); one a document macro holds with its comma
(`\newcommand{\SeMieee}{\IEEEmembership{, Senior Member,~IEEE}}`, 2503.14354) is kept, the comma the list's. **Witnesses**: 2508.00603, 1805.06045, 2202.10869,
2306.15457, 2408.00327, 2408.01902, 2408.01956, 2511.20003. A grade inside a plain list's `\IEEEauthorblockA` keeps its
text but raises two false content-check Warnings (the affiliation's event reads the grade's inner call as words; RED
`ieee_membership_grade_in_a_plain_affiliation_call_red`, post-merge IEGW). **Guards**: `perfect_kernel_batchp5a::ieee_membership_grade_is_the_readings_contact`,
batch63's `ieee_membership_*`, `perfect_kernel_batch98b::authblk_author_reads_ieee_grades`.

### 1019. Names led by their marks are names: a mark-led line is a names line above the block's first setter (MLN1)

**TeX.** A mark printed before a name is the name's superscript: `\author{$^{1}$Ann Able \and $^{2}$Bob Baker}` prints
"¹Ann Able ²Bob Baker" (pdflatex, 0 errors). **Perl.** `Base_Utility.pool.ltxml:706-707` ("Close to front? assume
affiliation", `$p < 8`): every mark-led piece is an affiliation, so such a block makes no creator and 2 "Orphaned
frontmatter annotation" Warnings. **Rust.** The resolver read a mark-led line as labelled affiliation entries unless it
was the block's first line answered by a later mark-led line of the block (`prefix`); `lines_of` cuts at every
`\and`, so each `\and` column's names, a second names row and names answered by `\institute` were one nameless
creator's affiliations, silently. Now `resolver::lines::names_led_by_marks` reads, per block, the marks each line shows
and the labels each mark-led line sets: the first **setter** is a mark-led line that is not its `\and` column's first
line (the column's first line is its author's name, as `column_first` reads it), setting each label once, every one
requested by a mark above it (not all set outside the block), the lines from it on setting no number no mark above
requests, every number requested above set from it on or by an affiliation call outside the block. A mark-led line whose every entry (an inkless one aside: a mark shown on the name before it) reads as names is a
**names line** when it lies above the first setter and some mark of it is answered by a later line, set outside the
block (`api::affiliation_set_labels`: a `label=`, the n-th `labelseq=` entry, each piece's leading marks — aa's and
llncs's numbered `\institute`, `\affiliation[..]`, a mark-led `\address`), or, no setter, every line of the block is
such a line. A names line is read by `names_line`, each mark after a separator the next name's (`marks_lead`, an
`\inst` after a comma and a mark glued to the one before too); the old `prefix` path and its entry reader (`names_of`)
are gone. A block making no name whose mark-led lines read as names is counted by a Warning. Decided by marks, requests
and set labels; the word shape (`reads_as_names`) is a necessary condition only. Unanswered marks keep their text in the
name, counted by the safety net where it sees the name's words change — not a trailing unanswered mark kept as the
name's `<sup>` (`$^3$Cat Cole` with only 1 and 2 set: 0 Warnings, no word lost;
`article_mark_led_unanswered_trailing_mark_uncounted_red`, revMLN1) — (the post-merge mark-text batch; PoS keeps a first name's leading mark:
`pos_leading_mark_kept_in_the_first_name_red`); an isotope line's mark is consumed as a label
(`article_unrequested_isotope_line_loses_its_mark_red`). Ambiguous by marks and left as affiliations: a row of
name-shaped text answering every request (`$^1$Zhipu AI \quad $^2$Deep Seek`), and a second names row of one name
answering one request (`article_mark_led_second_row_of_one_name_read_as_affiliation_red`), which reads as a one-line
affiliation does (batch63's `$^{1}$Carnegie Mellon`). **Witnesses**: 2507.23021, 2605.06126,
2505.14984, 1105.2204, 2205.03535 (PoS), 2606.07481 (oscmjournal), 2609.16600 (IEEEtran); 1805.08625, 1405.2400,
2001.00788, 0710.4115, gr-qc0606119 (the old prefix shapes). **Guards**: `perfect_kernel_batchmln1::{batchmln1_mark_led_names_read_as_names,
batchmln1_marked_affiliations_stay_affiliations}`, `perfect_kernel_batchfms2a2r4::prefix_marked_names_keep_their_notes`,
`perfect_kernel_batch78f::llncs_inst_leading_marks_keep_their_names`.

*Live rule: OD #459.*
